bench_setup = function() {
	set.seed(20261117)
	n = 200L
	w = rep(c(1, 0), each = n / 2L)
	t_true = rweibull(n, shape = 1.5, scale = 2 * exp(0.3 * w))
	y_L = numeric(n)
	y_R = numeric(n)
	for (i in seq_len(n)) {
		visits = cumsum(runif(8L, 0.3, 0.9))
		before = visits[visits < t_true[i]]
		after = visits[visits >= t_true[i]]
		y_L[i] = if (length(before)) max(before) else 0
		y_R[i] = if (length(after)) min(after) else Inf
	}
	list(y_L = y_L, y_R = y_R, w = w)
}

notes: Times the arm-difference median and restricted mean (four Turnbull NPMLE fits) on n=200 interval-censored subjects (100 per arm, 8 random visits each, about 15% right-censored, some left-censored at 0): interval::icfit's R EM against icenReg::ic_np's C++ EMICM, with the rest of EDI's helper copied unchanged. Both use (L, R] intervals; ic_np shifts open left endpoints by 1e-10 and drops nothing, icfit drops zero-mass intervals (neither changes the median pick or the area). tol 1e-4 because icfit's EM stops on a 1e-6 Kuhn-Tucker gap and is first-order, while ic_np stops on a 1e-10 log-likelihood change; a larger move would be a real estimator difference worth triage.
